name: Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic (1918)
description: A horizontal tricolour of yellow, black and red.
history: The Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic, uniting Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan, declared independence from Russia on 22 April 1918 and broke up on 26–28 May 1918 when its members went their separate ways. The tricolour attested for it by Ziggioto is the flag conventionally shown.
